title: ai-review.json
description: The review as SKILL.md describes it under Report file. run-claude.sh passes it to `claude -p --json-schema`, and run-codex.sh to `codex exec --output-schema` in the strict form strict-schema.jq derives from it; each writes what comes back to ai-review.json.

manual_review.description: What only a person can settle about this change; see SKILL.md. Empty on nearly every pull request. With any, a passing review does not approve.

skipped.description: True when SKILL.md says to stop before reviewing. Nothing is published for it, and the summary is the reason.

follows_up.description: On a follow-up: the earlier finding whose fix introduced this defect; see parts/follow-up.md.

raised_by.description: On a follow-up: the person whose comment raised this defect, which you confirmed in the code; see parts/follow-up.md.
